title: Mutant Catalogue
description: Deliberate defects that the test suite of a security-critical module must detect. docs/06-testing/02-tdd-coverage-mutation.md requires at least 80% mutation score for such modules; this is the catalogue that score is measured against. Each entry names one safety property by describing the edit that removes it, so a surviving mutant reads as a sentence about what is no longer guaranteed rather than as a line number.

root.description: Repository-relative directory copied to a temporary tree before mutating. Nothing is ever edited in place.

command.description: Argument vector, never a shell string.

threshold_percent.description: Lower bound from the testing standard. It may be raised here and never lowered below the standard, because the schema refuses a smaller number.

property.description: What stops being guaranteed if this edit survives. Written so the failure report is readable without opening the source.
